rust.name: src/main.rs:84:87: delete - in sim
rust.why: The tests reject a negative budget but never check that a nonnumeric budget is rejected instead of being treated as one second.

rust.name: src/sim.rs:26:5: replace default_seeds -> u64 with 0
rust.why: The successful bare sim invocation sets an explicit seed count, so the documented default of 20 can silently become zero.

rust.name: src/sim.rs:86:71: replace < with == in run
rust.why: The zero-budget test exercises the mandatory first run but never checks that a positive budget allows more runs while time remains.

rust.name: src/sim.rs:197:27: delete ! in rerun
rust.why: The nondeterminism test never makes the first rerun of a flagged seed match its saved output, the case where the flag alone must trigger confirmation.

rust.name: src/sim.rs:396:5: replace entropy -> u64 with 0
rust.why: The tests check seed diversity within one invocation but never compare independent invocations, so each can start from the same fixed seed sequence.
